description: This Java class 'EntityFieldMap' represents a condition expression for a set of field comparisons, typically used in building SQL-like query conditions within the Apache OFBiz framework. It manages a map of fields and their values, and provides methods to generate condition expressions, access fields, and iterate over the field entries.

classes.name: EntityFieldMap
classes.description: Final class representing a collection of field comparison conditions, encapsulating a map of field names to values and methods to generate and access condition expressions.

methods.name: makeConditionList
methods.description: Converts a map of field entries into a list of EntityExpr conditions using a specified comparison operator.

methods.name: EntityFieldMap (constructor)
methods.description: Constructs an EntityFieldMap from a map of fields, a comparison operator, and a join operator.

methods.name: getField
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with a given field name.

methods.name: containsField
methods.description: Checks if a specific field name exists in the field map.

methods.name: getFieldKeyIterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the field names.

methods.name: getFieldEntryIterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the field entries.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a visitor to process this condition object.
